blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Sunday said there is no truth to claims of former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV that impeachment court presiding officer Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero blocked him from appearing before the court to testify by not issuing him a subpoena. Gatchalian said the decision not to subpoena Trillanes as a witness in the trial of Vice President Sara Duterte did not depend solely with Escudero. “No,” Gatchalian answered when asked if Escudero prevented Trillanes from testifying, adding that it was discussed among the senators. “There was a consultation and there were a […]...
